title: Shot-match neutral grade (Investigation without the theme grade)
summary: Project settings for matching a reference frame in recon: Investigation room and lights, but highlight cap .97 (not .775), no chromatic aberration, light desaturation, no badge, no DOF.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: merge v1/settings.json theme + post into project.json settings (graphicsSuggested is a hint for the user's Graphics panel, never written)
usage.example: project.json settings.post = { grain: .03, vignette: .38, ao: true, contrast: 1.12, desat: .08, cap: .97, ca: 0 }; scene: S.recon = false; S.post.dof = null

doc.when: Any 'match this frame' / Style Studio shot-match run in recon, and any recon scene with saturated emissive colours (glowing people, neon, fire).
doc.avoid: Normal Investigation films where the milky capped highlights are the intended look.
gotchas: The grade is project-wide (settings.post): a scene cannot override it, so it is part of the shot's recipe.
The Investigation default cap .775 clips red first while green keeps rising: hot orange goes pastel/peach.
The default ca .0035 puts red/blue fringes on silhouettes.
Theme warmth/saturation in the user's Graphics were .12-.15 / 1.05-1.08 during the matches; .05 / .95 is closer to neutral (the user's call).
